welcome.title: Index taps
welcome.text: Windows will appear in front of you. Do what each one asks, as you would on a real one: they don't move or click, the cameras record your hands.|Press the button on the right side of the headset to start each step. Pressed while recording, it pauses.

done.title: All done
done.text: Thank you! You can take off the headset.|Review your recordings in the Hand recorder window.

stopped.title: Stopped
stopped.text: What was recorded so far is saved. Review it in the Hand recorder window.

sections.title: Hand size
sections.intro: First, your hand size: both hands up about 40 cm out, still.

prompts.text: Both hands about 40 cm out, still|Palms toward you, then backs toward you

sections.title: Index taps
sections.intro: When a button lights up, look at it and tap: thumb to index fingertip, light and quick, the way you'd click. Nothing happens when you tap: the cameras record your hand.

prompts.text: Right hand resting in your lap, the left one down and out of view.|Look at each button as it lights and tap once.
Left hand resting in your lap, the right one down and out of view.|Look at each button as it lights and tap once.
Right hand raised in front of your chest.|Palm down for the first half, then turn it edge-on.
Left hand raised.|Palm up for the first half, then palm toward your face.
Turn your head to the window on your right. Right hand low at your side.|A button showing 2: a double tap. A button showing hold: press until it goes out.
Two windows, left and right: the lit button jumps between them.|Turn your head to it and keep tapping with your right hand, the hand moving with you.
Both hands up. Each lit button says L or R: tap with that hand.
Right hand. Cyan: tap. Orange with a cross: bring the fingers about 1 cm short, don't touch.|Now and then rub the thumb along the side of the index instead.
Left hand resting on a desk or your knee, tapping from there.|A button showing hold: press until it goes out. The others: quick taps.
Your own pace: tap the lit button as often as you like, with either hand.|Move the hand around while you do: low, high, out to the side, close to your face.

says.tap: Your own pace: tap it as often as you like
